name: A cook to keep or let go
prompt: The new prep cook has been late four times in two weeks. The owner says it's your kitchen and your call.

choices.text: Let them go at the end of the shift

outcome.told: You tell them after close. They pack their knives and leave. There's a hole in next week's schedule now.

choices.text: Give them one more chance, and say plainly what happens next time

outcome.told: They're in early every day the next week, and they thank you for saying it straight.

failure.told: They're late again on Friday, and the line is a cook short through the rush.
